methodologyNotes: Published self-serve subscription pricing was collected per provider on the accessed date; because the major dating apps gate exact numbers behind in-app paywalls and apply documented dynamic pricing (varying by age, location, gender, and platform), the standard US 1-month published rate is recorded per tier and corroborated against a second dedicated 2026 pricing source. All figures are flat per-account per month in USD; these are consumer apps with no per-seat model, so billingModel is flat throughout. HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to consumer dating apps and are recorded null; longer 3/6/12-month commitments lower the per-month rate but are summarized in notes rather than as annualDiscountPct unless the provider publishes a discrete annual price, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier.

vendors.name: Tinder
vendors.provenance: Tinder does not publish a fixed self-serve price (in-app dynamic pricing by age/location); standard US 1-month rates taken from DatingApps.com's Tinder cost breakdown (accessed 2026-06-13), corroborated by a 2026 Tinder pricing search summary.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier: create a profile, swipe with a daily like limit, and match/message. No paid features.

plans.name: Tinder Plus
plans.notes: Unlimited likes, rewind last swipe, passport to swipe anywhere, no ads. Standard US 1-month rate; drops to ~$6.75/mo on 6-month and ~$4.50/mo on 12-month terms. Price is dynamic by age/location.

plans.name: Tinder Gold
plans.notes: Everything in Plus plus see who likes you, Top Picks daily, and one free Boost per month. Standard US 1-month rate; ~$11.25/mo on 6-month and ~$7.50/mo on 12-month terms.

plans.name: Tinder Platinum
plans.notes: Everything in Gold plus message before matching, priority likes, and see who you've liked. Standard US 1-month rate; ~$13.50/mo on 6-month and ~$9.00/mo on 12-month terms.

vendors.name: Bumble
vendors.provenance: Bumble lists tiers in-app with dynamic pricing; standard US 1-month rates for the three current tiers taken from VIDA Select's 2026 Bumble Boost vs Premium breakdown (accessed 2026-06-13), corroborated by a 2026 Bumble pricing search summary.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier: standard swiping and matching; women message first (Bumble model). No paid extras.

plans.name: Boost
plans.notes: See who liked you, rematch with expired connections, extend 24-hour matches, and unlimited Extends/Rematches. Standard US 1-month rate; lower per-month on 3/6-month terms; ~$269.99 lifetime.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Everything in Boost plus unlimited swipes, Travel mode, advanced filters, incognito mode, and weekly Spotlights. Standard US 1-month rate; lower per-month on longer terms; ~$269.99 lifetime.

plans.name: Premium+
plans.notes: Top tier: everything in Premium plus enhanced visibility and priority features. Standard US 1-month rate; lower per-month on longer commitments.

vendors.name: Hinge
vendors.provenance: Hinge's official help center (help.hinge.co Subscribing-to-Hinge-or-HingeX) returned 403 to automated fetch; standard US 1-month rates taken from a 2026 Hinge pricing search summary citing that help article, corroborated by VIDA Select's 2026 Hinge+ vs HingeX breakdown. Hinge applies dynamic pricing by age/location.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier: prompt-based profiles, up to 8 likes per day, and standard matching. No paid extras.

plans.name: Hinge+
plans.notes: Unlimited likes, advanced preferences/filters, and see everyone who liked you. Standard US 1-month rate ($32.99); ~$21/mo on 3-month ($64.99) and ~$16/mo on 6-month ($99.99) terms. Pricing may vary by location.

plans.name: HingeX
plans.notes: Everything in Hinge+ plus Skip the Line, Priority Likes, and enhanced recommendations. Standard US 1-month rate ($49.99); ~$33/mo on 3-month ($99.99) and ~$24/mo on 6-month ($149.99) terms. Pricing may vary by location.

vendors.name: Match
vendors.provenance: Match.com sells only multi-month terms billed upfront, presented as a per-month average; per-month rates by term taken from DatingApps.com's Match cost breakdown (accessed 2026-06-13), corroborated by a 2026 Match pricing search summary. No true 1-month plan, so monthlyUsd reflects the published 3-month per-month rate.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Core paid membership: unlimited likes/messaging, see who liked you, and matching tools. Per-month rate shown is the 3-month term ($31.99/mo, billed upfront); drops to $22.99/mo (6-month) and $18.99/mo (12-month).

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Adds Message Read receipts, profile boosts/likes upgrades, and first impressions. Per-month rate shown is the 3-month term ($34.99/mo, billed upfront); drops to $24.99/mo (6-month) and $19.99/mo (12-month).

vendors.name: OkCupid
vendors.provenance: OkCupid uses dynamic in-app pricing; standard US per-term rates taken from DatingApps.com's OkCupid cost breakdown (accessed 2026-06-13), corroborated by a 2026 OkCupid pricing search summary citing the official OkCupid help center.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier: detailed profiles, matching questions, likes, and messaging. No paid extras.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: See who likes you, advanced search/filters, read receipts, and ad-free browsing. Standard US 1-month rate; ~$26.66/mo on 3-month and ~$19.99/mo on 6-month terms. Pricing is dynamic per user.

vendors.name: Plenty of Fish
vendors.provenance: POF lists tiers in-app with region/term-varying pricing; standard US 1-month rates for the three current tiers taken from Roast.dating's 2026 'Is POF Worth It' breakdown (accessed 2026-06-13), corroborated by a 2026 POF pricing search summary. POF's own terms note prices can vary by region and should be verified in-app.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier: create a profile, add up to 8 photos, view profiles, and send/receive messages.

plans.name: POF Plus
plans.notes: Entry paid tier: see who liked you, image messaging, and priority profile visibility. Standard US 1-month rate; lower per-month on 6/12-month terms.

plans.name: POF Premium
plans.notes: Everything in Plus with expanded premium features and visibility. Standard US 1-month rate; per-month drops on longer commitments.

plans.name: POF Prestige
plans.notes: Top tier (rolled out 2025-2026; availability can be limited to select platforms): highest visibility and premium perks. Standard US 1-month rate.

vendors.name: eharmony
vendors.provenance: eharmony sells only multi-month Premium terms (no monthly plan), revealed at the post-questionnaire paywall; published per-month rates by term taken from DatingApps.com's eharmony cost breakdown (accessed 2026-06-13), corroborated by a 2026 eharmony pricing search summary. monthlyUsd reflects the published per-month rate for each term.

plans.name: Premium Light (6-month)
plans.notes: 6-month Premium term at $65.90/mo, billed upfront. Unlocks unlimited messaging, see all photos, and full Compatibility Matching. All eharmony Premium terms share the same features; only length differs.

plans.name: Premium Plus (12-month)
plans.notes: 12-month Premium term at $45.90/mo, billed upfront (lower per-month than the 6-month term). Same Premium feature set. Often promoted with 50% off the first 3 months.

plans.name: Premium Extra (24-month)
plans.notes: 24-month Premium term at $35.90/mo, billed upfront (lowest per-month rate). Same Premium feature set. Often promoted with 50% off the first 3 months.
